description: Black to play and capture the two white stones on the edge. Find the vital point.

B1.comment: Vital point. White cannot extend to A1 (suicide) and any other move loses the group next turn.

A1.comment: Slower. White extends at B1; you still need a follow-up.

C1.comment: Now the three white stones are captured.
